verdict.rationale: GitBook exposes a write-capable, OAuth-gated MCP server (create sites, open change requests, edit content) confirmed live at mcp.gitbook.com, showing some programmatic parity with UI actions, and a read-only MCP/llms.txt for docs content. However, no public REST/OpenAPI spec was found (openapi.json/swagger.json all 404), and there's no evidence covering broader UI capabilities like analytics, branding, redirects, or billing via API. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose REST API with OpenAPI spec, evidence that non-content UI settings (analytics, branding, domains, redirects) are API-accessible, and independent confirmation of full CRUD parity.
